description: This PHP source file defines the MyReviewAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving a list of performance reviews associated with the authenticated user within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements the CRUD interface but only the 'getAll' method is operational, allowing users to list their reviews with pagination and sorting.
